QuestInfo.name: The Gauntlet Is Beaten!
QuestInfo.0: You're bound to get something great for completing all the Hero's Gauntlet achievements!
QuestInfo.1: You'll receive a #i1142550##r#t1142550:# Medal#k and a #i3010516##r#t3010516:# Chair#k for completing all 4 Hero's Gauntlet achievements.
QuestInfo.2: You #bcompleted all Hero's Gauntlet achievements#k and received a #i1142550##r#t1142550:# Medal#k and a #i3010516##r#t3010516:# Chair#k. You rock!

0.0: You! You look like you have the squat legs and mighty cranium of a hero. Why don't you give our Hero's Gauntlet a shot and see if you pass muster?

yes.0: Good. I hope that your body does not come back disfigured and decimated like the last dozen competitors.
yes.1: Complete all four of the Hero's Gauntlet achievements, then pay me a visit. I will await the shattered husk of your once-vivacious personage with great anticipation.
yes.2: You will get your invitation between #b10am - 10pm every 20 minutes on the hour#k. Best of luck!

no.0: What, are you afraid of being mangled? Take a chance to be a hero! The invitation will come between #bQRQRQR and QRQRQR, every 20 minutes on the hour#k.

1.0: You have returned! And not a single limb missing!

yes.0: I suppose our gauntlet was too easy. Next time, you will not be so lucky.
yes.1: Take this and brag to all you know. You have earned the title of hero... for now.

default.0: I realize that these achievements aren't easy, but you must complete them all.
